# U.S. Gold Gymnastics & Cheer Academy

> Youth gymnastics and cheer academy in Roanoke, TX offering preschool, recreational, competitive team, and all-star cheer programs, plus camps, birthday parties, and college recruiting support. Phone: 817.491.9996. Address: 4000 Haslet-Roanoke Rd Ste 100, Roanoke, TX 76262.

## Programs

- [Preschool Gymnastics](https://usgoldgymclub.com/preschool): Classes for our youngest athletes, ages 18 months to 5 years.
- [Recreational Gymnastics](https://usgoldgymclub.com/recreational): Skill-based classes for boys and girls of all levels.
- [Competitive Team](https://usgoldgymclub.com/competitive): USAG competitive gymnastics training and meets.
- [All-Star Cheer](https://usgoldgymclub.com/cheer): Cheer and tumbling teams and classes.
- [College Recruits](https://usgoldgymclub.com/college-recruits): Recruiting guidance for collegiate-bound athletes.

## Events & Booking

- [Camps](https://usgoldgymclub.com/camps): School-break and summer camps.
- [Birthday Parties](https://usgoldgymclub.com/birthday-parties): Private gym birthday party packages.
- [Special Events](https://usgoldgymclub.com/special-events): Parents' night out, clinics, and open gyms.
- [Calendar](https://usgoldgymclub.com/calendar): Upcoming gym events and closures.
- [Contact & Free Trial](https://usgoldgymclub.com/contact): Book a free trial class or ask a question.

## About

- [About the Academy](https://usgoldgymclub.com/about): Facility, coaching staff, and philosophy.
- [Careers](https://usgoldgymclub.com/careers): Coaching and staff openings.
